title: Timbre Descriptor Evaluation
intro: Describe the audible character of each synthesizer sound using four bipolar scales.
internal_testing_notice: Internal team prototype only. Do not recruit external participants until the supervisor and ethics process permits it.
instructions: Use headphones in a quiet environment if available.
Play every sample at least once before rating it.
For each scale, choose the point that best matches the sound; 4 is the neutral midpoint.
Judge the sound you hear rather than trying to infer its synthesizer settings.
